findings.title: Pod ran past its activeDeadlineSeconds
findings.cause: the kubelet stopped the pod when it had run longer than its spec.activeDeadlineSeconds (10 s) (DeadlineExceeded), whatever its containers were doing; in a Job's pod template the deadline applies to each attempt, so every retry is stopped the same way

evidence.what: pod status is Failed, reason DeadlineExceeded
evidence.detail: Pod was active on the node longer than the specified deadline

findings.fix: Remove activeDeadlineSeconds from the Job's pod template, or raise it above how long one attempt takes; to bound the whole Job, set the Job's own spec.activeDeadlineSeconds.
